Help for grown-ups

Common questions

Restore purchases

Open the game and go to the Grown-ups area. Choose Restore Purchases, and sign in with the same Apple ID or Google account that bought the unlock. The purchase lives on that store account, so there is nothing to sign in to on our side.

If the unlock doesn't come back, write to us at the address above and say which store you used.

The free worlds and the $0.99 unlock

Free from the start: Free Play and the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds, with the explorers Astro and Zog.

The $0.99 unlock: All 10 worlds and every explorer. No subscription. One shared 3-use trial lets your child try locked worlds and explorers first.

The browser version includes the free content.

Playing in the browser

Tiny Trails: Space plays right in the browser from its game page, with nothing to install. The download is about 24 MB, best on Wi-Fi.

Deleting data

There's no profile or account to delete. To remove a game, uninstall it. Purchases stay with Apple or Google, and you manage or refund them in that store account. The details are in our privacy policy.

Something went wrong

Restarting the game fixes most hiccups. If it keeps happening, write to us at the address above with the game, the device (iPhone, iPad, Android, or a browser), and what happened. Please leave out a child's name, photo, or location.

The parental gate

Links that leave this site, like email and the app stores, first ask a grown-up a quick multiplication question.
